comparison.objective: Orient and nest a gas-burner head around an igniter, then seat its cap; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual rotational alignment and sequential nested placement versus narrow-tool coaxiality, impact regulation, and tiny-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Head and cap seated within pose tolerances without dropping versus four safe notch fractures and contained tangs.
comparison.reason: Both need damage-aware precision, but the tested mechanisms and outcomes differ.
